templates.name: Org chart
templates.hint: One head, three teams, and who reports to whom.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A["Chief executive"]
  B["Engineering"]
  C["Design"]
  D["Sales"]
  E["Backend"]
  F["Frontend"]
  G["Account managers"]
  A --> B
  A --> C
  A --> D
  B --> E
  B --> F
  D --> G

templates.name: System architecture
templates.hint: Three layers, left to right, with the data underneath.
templates.source:
flowchart LR
  subgraph G1 ["Clients"]
    A(["Web app"])
    B(["Mobile app"])
  end
  subgraph G2 ["Services"]
    C["API gateway"]
    D["Accounts"]
    E["Orders"]
  end
  subgraph G3 ["Data"]
    F["Database"]
    G["Queue"]
  end
  A --> C
  B --> C
  C --> D
  C --> E
  D --> F
  E --> F
  E --> G

templates.name: Process
templates.hint: Steps in a row, start to done.
templates.source:
flowchart LR
  A(["Start"])
  B["Step one"]
  C["Step two"]
  D["Step three"]
  E(["Done"])
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C --> D
  D --> E

templates.name: Decision
templates.hint: One question with a yes and a no.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Start"])
  B{"Is it ready?"}
  C["Go ahead"]
  D["Fix what is missing"]
  E(["Done"])
  A --> B
  B -->|"Yes"| C
  B -->|"No"| D
  D -.-> B
  C --> E

templates.name: Approval
templates.hint: A request, two reviews and a way back.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Submit request"])
  B{"Manager review"}
  C{"Finance review"}
  D(["Approved"])
  E["Revise the request"]
  A --> B
  B -->|"Approved"| C
  B -->|"Changes needed"| E
  C -->|"Approved"| D
  C -->|"Changes needed"| E
  E -.-> A

templates.name: Onboarding
templates.hint: From sign up to a first win.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Sign up"])
  B["Confirm email"]
  C("Set up a profile")
  D{"Pick a plan"}
  E["Free tour"]
  F["Add payment"]
  G(["First task done"])
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C --> D
  D -->|"Free"| E
  D -->|"Paid"| F
  E --> G
  F --> G

templates.name: Bug triage
templates.hint: Reproduce it, rate it, then fix or park it.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Bug reported"])
  B{"Can you reproduce it?"}
  C["Ask for details"]
  D{"How bad is it?"}
  E["Fix now"]
  F["Add to the backlog"]
  G["Verify the fix"]
  H(["Closed"])
  A --> B
  B -->|"No"| C
  C -.-> B
  B -->|"Yes"| D
  D -->|"Critical"| E
  D -->|"Minor"| F
  E --> G
  G --> H
  F --> H

templates.name: User flow
templates.hint: A visitor from the landing page to a result.
templates.source:
flowchart LR
  A(["Landing page"])
  B{"Signed in?"}
  C["Sign in"]
  D("Dashboard")
  E["Create an item"]
  F(["See the result"])
  A --> B
  B -->|"No"| C
  C --> D
  B -->|"Yes"| D
  D --> E
  E --> F

templates.name: Swimlanes
templates.hint: Who does what, one lane for each team.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  subgraph G1 ["Customer"]
    A(["Place an order"])
    F(["Order arrives"])
  end
  subgraph G2 ["Warehouse"]
    B["Receive the order"]
    C{"In stock?"}
    D["Pack and ship"]
  end
  subgraph G3 ["Support"]
    E["Tell the customer"]
  end
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C -->|"Yes"| D
  C -->|"No"| E
  D --> F

templates.name: State lifecycle
templates.hint: An item from draft to archived, with a way back.
templates.source:
flowchart LR
  A(["Draft"])
  B("In review")
  C("Approved")
  D("Published")
  E(["Archived"])
  A --> B
  B -->|"Accept"| C
  B -.->|"Reject"| A
  C --> D
  D --> E
  D -.->|"Edit"| A

templates.name: Checklist flow
templates.hint: Check each item in turn and stop at the first miss.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Start the check"])
  B{"Is the plan agreed?"}
  C{"Is the budget approved?"}
  D{"Is the team free?"}
  E(["All clear"])
  F["Fix the gap"]
  A --> B
  B -->|"Yes"| C
  B -->|"No"| F
  C -->|"Yes"| D
  C -->|"No"| F
  D -->|"Yes"| E
  D -->|"No"| F
  F -.-> B

templates.name: Swimlanes sideways
templates.hint: Lanes read left to right, which fits a wide screen.
templates.source:
flowchart LR
  subgraph G1 ["Customer"]
    A(["Place an order"])
    F(["Order arrives"])
  end
  subgraph G2 ["Warehouse"]
    B["Receive the order"]
    C{"In stock?"}
    D["Pack and ship"]
  end
  subgraph G3 ["Support"]
    E["Tell the customer"]
  end
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C -->|"Yes"| D
  C -->|"No"| E
  D --> F

templates.name: Request and approval with a loop
templates.hint: Ask, review, and go round again until it is approved.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Send a request"])
  B["Review it"]
  C{"Approved?"}
  D["Ask for changes"]
  E(["Done"])
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C -->|"Yes"| E
  C -->|"No"| D
  D --> B

templates.name: Incident response
templates.hint: Spot it, size it, fix it, and write it up.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Alert fires"])
  B["Acknowledge it"]
  C{"Is it serious?"}
  D["Call the team"]
  E["Fix and watch"]
  F(["Write it up"])
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C -->|"Yes"| D
  C -->|"No"| E
  D --> E
  E --> F

templates.name: Release pipeline
templates.hint: Build, test, stage and ship, with a stop on failure.
templates.source:
flowchart LR
  A(["Commit"])
  B["Build"]
  C{"Tests pass?"}
  D["Stage"]
  E(["Ship"])
  F["Fix it"]
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C -->|"Yes"| D
  C -->|"No"| F
  F -.-> B
  D --> E

templates.name: Support ticket
templates.hint: From a question to a reply, with a hand-off when it is stuck.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Ticket arrives"])
  B["Read it"]
  C{"Can you answer it?"}
  D["Reply"]
  E["Pass to a specialist"]
  F(["Close it"])
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C -->|"Yes"| D
  C -->|"No"| E
  E --> D
  D --> F

templates.name: Hiring pipeline
templates.hint: Applications to an offer, one stage at a time.
templates.source:
flowchart LR
  A(["Application"])
  B["Screen"]
  C["Interview"]
  D{"Good fit?"}
  E["Offer"]
  F(["Decline politely"])
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C --> D
  D -->|"Yes"| E
  D -->|"No"| F

templates.name: Order fulfilment
templates.hint: Order placed, paid, packed and delivered.
templates.source:
flowchart LR
  A(["Order placed"])
  B["Take payment"]
  C["Pack it"]
  D["Post it"]
  E(["Delivered"])
  F[("Stock records")]
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C --> D
  D --> E
  C -.-> F

templates.name: Content review
templates.hint: Draft, edit, approve and publish, with edits sent back.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Draft"])
  B["Edit"]
  C{"Approved?"}
  D["Publish"]
  E(["Done"])
  F["Send back"]
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C -->|"Yes"| D
  C -->|"No"| F
  F -.-> B
  D --> E

templates.name: Project plan
templates.hint: Periods and what happens in each, grouped in sections.
templates.source:
timeline
  title Project plan
  section Plan
    Week 1 : Kick off : Agree the goal
    Week 2 : First draft
  section Build
    Week 3 : Review
    Week 4 : Ship

templates.name: Sign in
templates.hint: A user, an app and a server, with a yes and a no.
templates.source:
sequenceDiagram
  actor U as User
  participant A as App
  participant S as Server
  U->>A: Enter email and password
  A->>S: Check the details
  alt Details match
    S-->>A: Signed in
    A-->>U: Show the home page
  else Details do not match
    S-->>A: Refuse
    A-->>U: Show the error
  end

templates.name: Request and reply
templates.hint: A client asks, a server looks it up, the answer comes back.
templates.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant S as Server
  participant D as Database
  C->>S: Ask for the page
  S->>D: Look up the data
  D-->>S: Return the rows
  S-->>C: Send the page
  Note over C,S: The client waits for the reply

templates.name: Launch plan
templates.hint: Tasks in three sections, each starting when the last one ends.
templates.source:
gantt
  title Launch plan
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section Plan
  Write the brief :a1, 2026-01-05, 5d
  Agree the scope :a2, after a1, 3d
  section Build
  Build it :b1, after a2, 10d
  Test it :b2, after b1, 4d
  section Ship
  Announce it :after b2, 2d

templates.source:
pie title Where the time goes
  "Meetings" : 20
  "Writing" : 30
  "Reviews" : 15
  "Planning" : 10

templates.name: Order states
templates.hint: An order from new to delivered, with a way out.
templates.source:
stateDiagram-v2
  state New
  state Paid
  state Shipped
  state Delivered
  state Cancelled
  [*] --> New
  New --> Paid : pay
  Paid --> Shipped : ship
  Shipped --> Delivered : arrive
  New --> Cancelled : cancel
  Paid --> Cancelled : refund
  Delivered --> [*]
  Cancelled --> [*]
